kept.name: e:fw-bigvault
kept.depicts: A massive circular green-phosphor bank vault door with twelve perimeter bolts, heavy right-hand hinges, and a three-spoke locking wheel.

kept.name: e:fw-romcab
kept.depicts: A tall green-phosphor equipment rack housing four stacked DIP-pinned ROM cartridges beneath a black panel of eight blinking indicator bars.

kept.name: e:fw-drawers
kept.depicts: A three-by-two bank of six dark green metal drawers, each fitted with a bright horizontal pull.

kept.name: e:fw-cmos
kept.depicts: A round green coin-cell battery held by four retainer tabs with a bright plus sign stamped in the center.

kept.name: e:fw-dipsw
kept.depicts: A green four-position DIP switch block with three toggles pushed up and the third pushed down.

kept.name: e:fw-fan
kept.depicts: A square dark-green chassis fan housing with four corner screw holes and a four-blade spinning rotor.

kept.name: e:fw-capsule
kept.depicts: A green-bordered rectangular module with bottom pins and a bright padlock emblem centered in a dark recess.

kept.name: e:fw-spiclip
kept.depicts: A green test clip clamped over a dark chip body, with two probe leads extending from the top and four pins below.

kept.name: e:fw-optrom
kept.depicts: A dark-green expansion circuit board with bottom edge-connector fingers and one large bright chip beside two smaller ICs.

kept.name: e:fw-reset
kept.depicts: A bright green rounded tactile switch set into a dark green square housing.

kept.name: e:fw-postcard
kept.depicts: A dark-green plug-in circuit card with bottom edge-connector pins, a bright LED, and a two-character readout showing BF.

kept.name: e:fw-ucode
kept.depicts: A green ten-pin DIP chip with a central circular quartz window revealing the dark silicon die inside.

kept.name: e:fw-tpm
kept.depicts: A square green-bordered chip housing a small padlock with a bright shackle and a dark keyhole.

kept.name: e:fw-jtag
kept.depicts: A black-centered green rectangular shroud containing two rows of five square pin contacts.

kept.name: e:fw-secureboot
kept.depicts: A green stepped heraldic shield enclosing a dark field with a bright horizontal bar in the center.
A hovering green-phosphor rectangular module with bright upper and lower plates and a central visor that blinks dark and light.

rework.name: e:fw-beeper
rework.depicts: A small dark-green circular piezo speaker with a bright green cross aperture positioned to emit animated sound pulses.

deleted.name: e:fw-vault
deleted.depicts: A miniature circular green vault door with a three-spoke wheel and a single right-hand hinge.
deleted.reason: Redundant miniature duplicate of the Boot Vault door.

deleted.depicts: A dark green rectangular bezel holding a two-digit seven-segment LED readout glowing bright green.
deleted.reason: Duplicates the POST diagnostic code concept already represented better by the POST Card.

deleted.name: e:fw-flash
deleted.depicts: A small green ten-pin dual-inline chip package with a bright square pin-one orientation dot.
deleted.reason: Generic DIP chip that overlaps with the more distinctive Microcode EPROM and SOIC Clip.

deleted.name: e:fw-plate
deleted.depicts: A sturdy green phosphor padlock with a bright crossbar and a dark warded keyhole.
deleted.reason: Generic padlock icon that overlaps with the TPM Chip and other security locks across layers.

deleted.depicts: A wide dark-green terminal panel with an inverted header bar above the pixel-art word BOOT.
deleted.reason: ART-STYLE rule 2: text panel ("BOOT") is the whole prop

deleted.name: e:fw-bootorder
deleted.depicts: A small green-framed rectangle standing on two stubs with three dark and light blocks arranged inside.
deleted.reason: Visually unclear rectangle with abstract blocks that does not read well as boot order.

deleted.name: e:fw-acpi
deleted.depicts: A green circular standby-power icon formed by a broken ring and a vertical line at the top.

deleted.name: e:fw-nvram
deleted.depicts: Four vertical dark-green memory columns with bright caps standing on a shared bus, three filled high and one low.
deleted.reason: Duplicates the NVRAM variable storage concept already covered by Variable Chest.

deleted.name: e:fw-floppy
deleted.depicts: A miniature green 3.5-inch floppy disk with a top sliding shutter, bottom label, and corner notch.
deleted.reason: Generic retro floppy disk filler without a strong firmware-specific identity.

deleted.name: e:fw-key
deleted.depicts: A horizontal green skeleton key with a cross-slotted circular bow on the left and two warded teeth on the right.
deleted.reason: Generic skeleton key whose UEFI signing concept is better served by Secure Boot.

deleted.name: e:fw-uart
deleted.depicts: A rectangular green-framed black header with three square pins in a row, the leftmost glowing bright green.
deleted.reason: Too visually similar to the JTAG Header as a dark pin-header block.

deleted.name: e:fw-watchdog
deleted.depicts: A dark-green framed monitor holding a bright horizontal bar approaching a vertical threshold line on the right.
deleted.reason: Visually abstract bar that duplicates the Deadman Countdown watchdog timer in the kernel layer.
